meta.description: Reconstruct ancestral states at internal phylogenetic nodes for sequences (PAML codeml, IQ-TREE --ancestral, GRASP, FastML), discrete traits (corHMM hidden-rate Markov, ape::ace, phytools::make.simmap stochastic mapping, BayesTraits), and continuous traits (phytools::fastAnc, geiger Brownian/OU, RPANDA). Use when designing constructs for ancestral protein resurrection, tracing trait evolution along a tree, performing stochastic character mapping, testing models of trait evolution (BM vs OU vs EB), inferring ancestral genome content via Dollo or DTL reconciliation, or quantifying ancestral-state uncertainty for downstream comparative analyses.

scientific_integrity.detail: Executed outputs were checked for concrete sequence, posterior, state, model, and uncertainty values; no fabricated result was accepted.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill marks OUwie ancestral points as exploratory and explicitly does not claim uncertainty; unsupported transformed-model ancestral outputs are refused.

methodological_ground.detail: Seeded stochastic mapping, taxon reconciliation, strict posterior checks, and documented package-version boundaries were independently exercised.

code_usability.detail: A current PAML 4.10.10 codon reconstruction completed successfully, but the shipped parser rejected its real rst marginal rows as absent.

functional_suitability.note: Broad advertised coverage is substantial, but the PAML codon marginal-posterior route is incompatible with current real output.

reliability.note: Strict error paths and reconciliation are generally clear; codon rst parsing remains a critical uncovered path.

performance_context.note: Runnable examples are bounded and practical; large-data cost expectations could be more explicit.

agent_usability.note: Workflows and decision boundaries are useful, but categorical corHMM superiority slogans conflict with the conditional method-selection guidance.

human_usability.note: Clear scope, caveats, and recovery language; one method-comparison claim is overgeneralized.

security.note: No sensitive-data or unsafe execution issue found; tool execution remains user-controlled.

maintainability.note: Version and unsupported-source boundaries are documented, though parser coverage missed a standard codon output form.

agent_specific.note: Strong explicit seeding, taxon reconciliation, model refusal, and posterior validation; stale categorical comparison phrasing remains.

inputs.label: PAML protein and codon ASR
inputs.note: Protein rst parsers pass; real PAML 4.10.10 codon rst parsing fails on marginal rows.

assertions.text: Real PAML protein reconstruction yields parsed ancestors and posterior records
assertions.note: Two independently retained protein rst surfaces each yielded 7 nodes × 110 sites (770 posterior records).

assertions.text: Real current PAML codon reconstruction yields parsed marginal posteriors
assertions.note: codeml 4.10.10 exited 0 and wrote a 179,896-byte rst; parser raised 'PAML rst contains no marginal site rows'.

assertions.text: Empty PAML probability input returns an explicit no-data state
assertions.note: Empty input returned status no_data, zero counts, null summaries, and a no-assessment message.

assertions.text: Codon parser failure is explicit rather than silently converted to confidence output
assertions.note: The parser raised a stable ValueError instead of reporting a false successful parse.

inputs.label: IQ-TREE marginal protein ASR
inputs.note: Fresh exact IQ-TREE run and independent strict posterior validation succeeded.

assertions.text: Packaged IQ-TREE workflow completes on the public protein fixture
assertions.note: IQ-TREE 2.4.0 produced the expected ancestral-state artifacts.

assertions.text: Every real posterior row has finite values summing to one and a valid maximum state
assertions.note: 660 rows, 6 internal nodes, 110 sites, 20 posterior columns; maximum row-sum error was 0.00003 and states matched argmax.

assertions.text: Malformed or incomplete posterior tables are rejected
assertions.note: Missing columns, empty rows, bad sums, wrong argmax, and NaN fixtures all failed with actionable ValueErrors.

assertions.text: Run reproducibility seed is captured in the output log
assertions.note: Fresh run log records IQ-TREE generated seed 722488.

inputs.label: Discrete trait stochastic mapping and hidden rates
inputs.note: Seeded 1,000-map run, missing-taxon failure, and documented corHMM version boundary checked.

assertions.text: Stochastic mapping requires an explicit reproducibility seed
assertions.note: Missing seed exits before input work and requests exactly one reproducibility seed.

assertions.text: Seeded fixture produces the requested stochastic maps and node summaries
assertions.note: The 30-tip fixture yielded 1,000 maps and node posterior summaries with seed 20260928.

assertions.text: Trait and tree taxa are reconciled before inference
assertions.note: Missing rows were rejected with named taxa and row-alignment recovery guidance.

assertions.text: corHMM GitHub 2.10.5 support is not falsely represented as tested
assertions.note: The workflow pins tested CRAN 2.8 and explicitly records GitHub 2.10.5 as untested/unsupported.

inputs.label: Continuous-trait BM and OU reconstruction
inputs.note: BM intervals and real fitted-object OUwie exploratory output were inspected; default single-regime identify diagnostic limitation reproduced.

assertions.text: BM selection uses finite model scores and returns node estimates with 95% intervals
assertions.note: 35-tip fixture selected BM; 34 ancestral estimates and 34 fastAnc 95% confidence intervals were returned.

assertions.text: OU branch invokes OUwie 3.0.3 on its actual fitted object
assertions.note: OUwie.anc(fitted_object, knowledge=TRUE) returned 29 point estimates.

assertions.text: OUwie ancestral points are clearly labeled exploratory and not uncertainty-bearing
assertions.note: Status exploratory_point_estimates_only; uncertainty is NULL and documented as not provided by OUwie.anc.

assertions.text: Known single-regime OUwie identify diagnostic is disclosed and handled
assertions.note: Default check.identify=TRUE error was reproduced; candidate uses check.identify=FALSE after its documented validation path.

inputs.label: GRASP official current CLI and artifacts
inputs.note: Official 2024 JAR and packaged shell run on a bounded protein fixture; promised artifacts validated.

assertions.text: Current official GRASP CLI accepts the packaged option sequence
assertions.note: Official JAR help and actual invocation confirmed current flags and positional input order.

assertions.text: Packaged wrapper completes using the supported runtime environment
assertions.note: Candidate wrapper completed when the prepared conda runtime was on PATH.

assertions.text: GRASP output includes usable ancestral sequence and tree artifacts
assertions.note: Seven ancestor sequences of 110 columns and the eight-tip tree were validated.

assertions.text: Structured GRASP output parses with the promised fields
assertions.note: Output validation confirmed all four expected JSON fields.

inputs.label: Unsupported transformed-model outputs
inputs.note: Each transformed-model winner was forced independently and the no-substitution refusal verified.

assertions.text: EB winner does not substitute an original-tree BM result
assertions.note: Candidate refused EB ancestral reconstruction with an explicit not-implemented message.

assertions.text: lambda winner does not substitute an original-tree BM result
assertions.note: Candidate refused lambda ancestral reconstruction with an explicit not-implemented message.

assertions.text: kappa and delta winners both refuse unsupported output
assertions.note: Both cases failed closed with model-specific messages.

assertions.text: Refusal explicitly states no original-tree fastAnc/contMap result was substituted
assertions.note: All four refusals included the explicit no-substitution boundary.

inputs.label: No-data, taxon/outgroup boundaries, and method claims
inputs.note: Empty/no-data and taxon/outgroup guards pass; broad corHMM slogans remain in prose.

assertions.text: Empty probability results are reported as no-data rather than a successful reconstruction
assertions.note: Explicit no_data status and unknown quality were returned.

assertions.text: Missing trait taxa are rejected before inference
assertions.note: Fresh missing-taxon case emitted named missing taxa and recovery guidance.

assertions.text: An absent IQ-TREE outgroup is rejected before accepted reconstruction
assertions.note: Independent initial audit negative-fixture evidence was reinspected; candidate rejects the absent requested outgroup.

assertions.text: corHMM comparison is consistently conditional on data/model suitability
assertions.note: Usage guide still says corHMM 'supersedes simpler Mk approaches' and is the 'modern standard' despite conditional model-selection guidance elsewhere.

assertions.text: Known unsupported surfaces and uncertainty limits are stated without overstating coverage
assertions.note: No prepared real codon rst fixture, GitHub corHMM 2.10.5, and OUwie point-estimate uncertainty limits are not misrepresented as validated support.

key_strengths: IQ-TREE posterior parsing validates finite probabilities, normalization, and maximum-state consistency against a real current run.
Stochastic mapping now requires explicit seeding and reconciles tree and trait taxa before inference.
BM intervals and OUwie fitted-object point estimates are separated with an explicit uncertainty boundary.
Unsupported EB, lambda, kappa, and delta ancestral outputs fail closed rather than substituting an unrelated tree-space method.

recommendations.title: Parse real PAML codon marginal rows
recommendations.problem: PAML 4.10.10 successfully generated codon ancestral output, but the shipped parser rejected all codon marginal rows as absent. This breaks a central advertised PAML codon posterior route.
recommendations.root_cause: The parser's marginal-row pattern assumes protein-style extant-state columns and does not account for the multiple codon/state tokens preceding the colon in codon rst output.
recommendations.fix: Implement parsing for the actual codon rst row grammar and add a real, small PAML codeml codon rst fixture/regression. Assert node/site cardinality and posterior normalization against the successful codeml output before claiming codon posterior support.

recommendations.title: Make corHMM superiority claims conditional
recommendations.problem: The usage guide calls corHMM a replacement for simpler Mk approaches and a modern standard while the method-selection matrix elsewhere limits it to cases with rate-variation rationale.
recommendations.root_cause: Legacy categorical comparative-method language was not reconciled with the new scenario-based method-selection guidance.
recommendations.fix: Rewrite these statements to explain when hidden-rate corHMM models are warranted, retain Mk alternatives for suitable simpler questions, and make the limitation consistent across the guide.
